verdict.rationale: Steel's docs explicitly describe stealth mode (bot-detection evasion + CAPTCHA solving in one flag) and both Managed Residential Proxies and Bring-Your-Own-Proxy options, directly matching the story; a community comment corroborates that custom proxies work. Missing for 10: explicit geo-targeting/country-selection documentation and independent hands-on verification that stealth actually reduces bot-blocking in production.
